transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I, um... I guess I came in because... I just feel like everything that goes wrong is my fault. I don't know. Like I'm a bad employee, and... and a bad homeowner. I just... I feel like I deserve to lose everything I've worked for.
Did these feelings begin after a specific stressful event or change in your life?
I suppose... it started after I bought my townhouse. It's been about two years and three months, I think. Just... the pressure of keeping it all together started to build up.
During this time, have you often lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah... I guess so. I don't really do much lately. I used to... I don't know, plan brunches, paint in the spare room. Go hiking sometimes, or sign up for networking events. But... I don't know. Now it all just feels like... like tasks. Like I'm just pretending to care about them.
Since these feelings and loss of interest began, have you had any period when they completely went away?ф

I don't think so... no. Looking back, the... the low mood and not caring about things, it's been there almost the whole time since this started. I mean, there were maybe brief periods where I could function a little better, I guess. But... no, they never completely went away.
Since this began, how has your energy level been?
I don't know... just low, I guess. I haven't really paid much attention to it.
Since this began, have you often felt excessively worried or on edge?
I don't think so... no. I haven't really noticed feeling like that.
Since these symptoms began, has there been any period lasting two months or longer when you felt generally okay?
Not that I can remember, no. It just kind of... stays like this. I haven't really had a stretch like that.
How has your sleep been during this time?

Not great. Um... most nights I just lie awake for hours. Just... listening to the house settle. And then I usually end up waking up around three or four anyway... and I can't really get back to sleep before work. So... yeah.
During this period, have you often had trouble concentrating or making decisions?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I still get my work done. It hasn't really been an issue, I guess.
During this period, have you often felt badly about yourself or believed that you were not good enough?

...Yeah. I guess... that's actually why I came in. I just... I can't really stop feeling like everything that goes wrong is my fault. Like I'm just a bad employee... and a bad homeowner. I don't know, I just... feel like I deserve to lose what I've worked for.
